step1_analysis.description: A 10-transistor CAM cell consisting of a 6T SRAM core for data storage and a 4T NOR-type compare network for fast tag matching. The matchline is pulled down upon a mismatch between the stored data and the search lines.

paper_reference.title: A Novel Low-Voltage Content-Addressable-Memory (CAM) Cell with a Fast Tag-Compare Capability Using Partially Depleted (PD) SOI CMOS Dynamic-Threshold (DTMOS) Techniques

t_delay_mismatch.description: Matchline evaluate delay during a mismatch condition

sky130_expected.calculation: R_on of two series NMOS (W=5u) is ~540 ohms. With C_ML=10fF, tau = 5.4ps. Delay is roughly 10-50ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 at 1.8V is much faster than the paper's 0.7V older SOI process. Also, the testbench uses a single-cell 10fF load instead of a full column load.

v_ml_mismatch.description: Matchline voltage level during a mismatch (VOL)

sky130_expected.calculation: Voltage divider between 50k pull-up resistor and ~540 ohm pull-down network. V = 1.8 * 540 / 50540 = 0.019V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the chosen pull-up resistor size. 50k gives a very solid VOL near 0V.

v_ml_match.description: Matchline voltage level during a match (VOH)

sky130_expected.calculation: Pull-down network is completely off. Matchline is pulled to VDD by the 50k resistor.
sky130_expected.reasoning: No static current flows through the matchline during a match, so it reaches full VDD.

t_write.description: Time required to write data into the SRAM cell

sky130_expected.calculation: Access transistor R_on ~ 270 ohms charging internal node capacitance ~10fF. tau = 2.7ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Writing a single cell in Sky130 at 1.8V is extremely fast compared to a full array write.

p_avg_search.description: Average power consumption during a search operation (mismatch)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the static current through the pull-up resistor during a mismatch.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure SRAM write time, matchline evaluate delay, match/mismatch voltage levels, and search power. Fixes are applied to floating/disconnected nodes caused by extraction errors to restore proper SRAM cross-coupling.
step3_testbench.spice:
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* Include sky130 library
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
XM1 N5 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 LABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_2 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 LABEL_NET_4 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 LABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 LABEL_NET_7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 N0 LABEL_NET_8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 N2 LABEL_NET_9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Fixes for floating/disconnected nodes (restoring SRAM cross-coupling)
V_N0 N0 N2 0
V_L7 LABEL_NET_7 N1 0
V_L4 LABEL_NET_4 N2 0
V_L8 LABEL_NET_8 VDD 0
V_L9 LABEL_NET_9 VDD 0

* Power supply
V_VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Matchline pull-up and load
R_ML N3 VDD 50k
C_ML N3 0 10f

* Initial conditions to ensure write flips the state
.ic v(N1)=0 v(N2)=1.8 v(N3)=1.8

* Stimulus
V_WL WL 0 PWL(0 0 1n 0 1.1n 1.8 4n 1.8 4.1n 0 20n 0)
V_WL2 LABEL_NET_2 WL 0
V_WL6 LABEL_NET_6 WL 0

V_BL LABEL_NET_5 0 PWL(0 1.8 20n 1.8)
V_BLB LABEL_NET_1 0 PWL(0 0 20n 0)

* Search lines
* 0-5n: idle
* 6-9n: search 1 (Match, since Q=1)
* 12-15n: search 0 (Mismatch, since Q=1)
V_SL LABEL_NET_0 0 PWL(0 0 5.9n 0 6n 1.8 9n 1.8 9.1n 0 20n 0)
V_SLB LABEL_NET_3 0 PWL(0 0 11.9n 0 12n 1.8 15n 1.8 15.1n 0 20n 0)

.control
tran 10p 20n
meas tran t_write_1 trig v(WL) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran v_ml_match min v(N3) from=6n to=9n
meas tran v_ml_mismatch min v(N3) from=12n to=15n
meas tran t_delay_mismatch trig v(LABEL_NET_3) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 fall=1
let p_total = -i(V_VDD)*1.8
meas tran p_avg_search avg p_total from=12n to=15n
print t_write_1 v_ml_match v_ml_mismatch t_delay_mismatch p_avg_search
quit
.endc
